Return a list of output lines, rather than printing them. Preserve leading spaces and use no trailing spaces. n >= 0. Use sizes 1..n then n-1..1. A size-i row contains i stars, 2*(n-i) spaces, and i more stars. n=0 returns [].

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    3
  ],
  "expected": [
    "*    *",
    "**  **",
    "******",
    "**  **",
    "*    *"
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    1
  ],
  "expected": [
    "**"
  ]
}
Hint

The middle gap shrinks by two until the wings meet.

Complexity: O(n^2) characters of time and output
